checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Lower hand supports head; upper hand closes around one light dumbbell.
checks.feet: Side lying torso and legs remain stable while forearm rotates upward with elbow held at ninety degrees.
checks.movement: Lie on side, lower arm supporting head. Hold a light dumbbell with upper elbow bent ninety degrees and upper arm kept alongside torso. Rotate forearm upward sixty degrees and lower with control; pelvis and legs stay still. 3.5 seconds raise, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
